subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly China Southern via Guangzhou to Xi’an and stay four nights in a 4★ hotel. You see the Terracotta Army, the Ancient City Wall, the Bell and Drum Tower Square and Muslim Quarter, both Wild Goose Pagodas, and Tang-style night sights, with a Hanfu Qin Dynasty banquet upgrade and one bottle of water per day included. No shopping stops are scheduled.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 17–21 2026 to Mar 12–16 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Ever-Bright Tang Boulevard: A Tang-dynasty-style night district in Xi'an, lit up for evening strolls on arrival day.
placeDesc.Ancient City Wall: Xi'an's Ming-dynasty city wall, one of the best-preserved ancient city walls in China.
placeDesc.Bell and Drum Tower Square: The square around Xi'an's historic Bell Tower and Drum Tower in the city centre.
placeDesc.Muslim Quarter: A busy Xi'an district of street food stalls and shops near the Drum Tower.
placeDesc.Daming Palace Danfeng Gate: The main gate of the Tang-dynasty Daming Palace in Xi'an.
placeDesc.Yongxingfang Food Street: A heritage food street in Xi'an showcasing traditional Shaanxi snacks and crafts.
placeDesc.Small Wild Goose Pagoda: A Tang-dynasty Buddhist pagoda in Xi'an, close to the Xi'an Museum.
placeDesc.Xi’an Museum: A museum in Xi'an on the grounds near the Small Wild Goose Pagoda, showing local history.
placeDesc.Big Wild Goose Pagoda: A landmark Tang-dynasty pagoda in Xi'an; the tour visits its north square with the musical fountain.
placeDesc.Terracotta Army: The famous army of life-size clay warriors buried with Qin Shi Huang, visited in Pits 1, 2 and 3.
placeDesc.Xingqing Palace Park: A Tang-style lakeside imperial garden in Xi'an.
